Precision and efficiency for the best in the trade. Classy looks for everyone who likes killing in style. Every time someone in Havana lights a cigar…

Category: V. Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 6 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild, Silencer • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. This weapon cannot make Ricochet Attacks. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6) and, if the target is meat, they must succeed on a DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs Check or else suffer 3d6 damage which ignores and does not ablate their armor. This is in addition to the Aimed Shot’s usual damage. This weapon can be reloaded without an Action by sacrificing the user's Move Action as long as they have at least one other open hand.

Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, Silencer (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
